draft.subject: Next step for River Works on Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks again for making time for the kickoff last week. You've already got a project created, which is the main thing — projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so adding your real tasks there is usually the step that makes everything else click.

If it's useful, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through whatever's in your way.

Best,
Nadia
